pages.title: Spicy Placenta
pages.text: Race 12, the last: New York, 8.9 miles. Password: LIBERTY. Hyper's reviewer, going through the songs: 'Spicy Placenta - yeeurck!' Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: The word
pages.text: Skitching was named in New York: a journalist there saw skaters hanging on to cars and trucks. Dave Ralston and Dave Warfield both read the article and each pitched the game at EA's weekly meeting.
